title: Library
subtitle: Linked executables start a session when opened. Games can send text directly to the texthooker.

emptyBody: Link a visual novel or game's executable to its NihongoTracker entry to track it automatically.

modal.executableHint: Optional when the work executable path is set. Otherwise, enter the process name to detect it.
modal.launchPathHint: Optional full path. Lets the companion open this work from the library.
modal.hookerPathHint: Optional executable or .bat/.cmd script to start the external hooker.
modal.nativeHookHint: Captures Japanese text from the running game with LunaHook. Windows only.
modal.enabledHint: Turn it off to stop tracking this work without deleting it.
modal.overlayHint: Opens only the reading overlay and enables LunaHook for this VN.
modal.filterChineseHint: Drops Chinese lines and translations glued to the Japanese, only for this work.
